lore.headline: TWO SEASONS, TWO KINGS, ZERO MERCY
lore.subhead: The archive opens with 2024-25 and 2025-26, and nobody comes out clean.
body: Vishal won 2024-25 from the top seed. Arnav B answered by winning 2025-26 a year after finishing 10th, which tells you everything about this league's attention span. John J made the playoffs both years, finished 3rd and then 2nd, and owns zero rings. Parth lost the 2024-25 final and settled for 4th the next year. Bridesmaid energy.

Eshan B is the league's punching bag: last place in 2025-26, 0-4 against Phil, 0-4 against Chris, 0-3 against Parth. Keshav is +6.0 a year over all-play, so whatever he thinks he's doing, it's mostly luck. Sagar averages a 10.5 finish. Consistency is a virtue, they said.
